title: Zarr v3 node metadata
description: The `zarr.json` document of a Zarr v3 group or array (Zarr core specification 3.1, https://zarr-specs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/v3/core/index.html), including the consolidated metadata written by zarr-python. Unofficial JSON Schema authored by hamk-uas/stac-schema-explorer to document and check metadata embedded in data files; it is not published or endorsed by the maintainers of the format or convention.

node_type.title: Node type
node_type.description: Whether the node is an array or a group.

oneOf.title: Array
oneOf.description: An n-dimensional array stored as chunks, with its own data type, chunking and codecs.

oneOf.title: Group
oneOf.description: A container of arrays and other groups.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Arbitrary user metadata of the node as a JSON object. Conventions (Zarr conventions declared in `zarr_conventions`, CF and ACDD declared in `Conventions`) define their fields here.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: Length of each dimension of the array.

data_type.title: Data type
data_type.description: Type of the array elements: a core data type, `r<N>` for N raw bits, or a registered extension data type.

oneOf.title: Boolean
oneOf.description: True or false, one byte per value.

oneOf.title: 64-bit complex
oneOf.description: Two 32-bit floats: real and imaginary part.

oneOf.title: 128-bit complex
oneOf.description: Two 64-bit floats: real and imaginary part.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the extension, registered in zarr-developers/zarr-extensions or a URL.

must_understand.title: Must understand
must_understand.description: False when a reader that does not know the extension may ignore it.

chunk_grid.title: Chunk grid
chunk_grid.description: How the array is divided into chunks.

oneOf.title: Rectilinear
oneOf.description: Chunks of varying size along each dimension (registered extension).

chunk_shape.title: Chunk shape
chunk_shape.description: Shape of each chunk of a regular grid.

chunk_key_encoding.title: Chunk key encoding
chunk_key_encoding.description: How chunk grid coordinates become storage keys.

name.title: Encoding
name.description: Name of the chunk key encoding.

oneOf.title: Zarr v2
oneOf.description: Keys like `0.1.2`, as in Zarr v2 (core).

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Parameters of the chunk key encoding.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Character between chunk coordinates in a key.

fill_value.title: Fill value
fill_value.description: Value of elements that have not been written: missing chunks are read as filled with it. Its JSON form depends on the data type: a number, true/false, "NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity" or a hexadecimal bit pattern for floats, or a two-element array for complex numbers.

codecs.title: Codecs
codecs.description: Chain of codecs that encode each chunk, applied in order when writing.

items.title: Codec
items.description: One step of the chain that encodes chunks: array → array codecs, exactly one array → bytes codec, then bytes → bytes codecs.

name.title: Bytes codec
name.description: Serializes array elements to bytes in a fixed byte order (array → bytes; core).

name.title: Transpose codec
name.description: Permutes the dimensions of each chunk before encoding (array → array; core).

checksum.title: Checksum
checksum.description: Whether a checksum is stored with each compressed chunk.

name.title: Blosc codec
name.description: Blosc meta-compression, optionally with byte or bit shuffling (bytes → bytes; core).

cname.title: Compressor
cname.description: Compressor used inside Blosc, for example lz4, zstd or zlib.

shuffle.title: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Shuffle filter applied before compression: noshuffle, shuffle (bytes) or bitshuffle.

typesize.title: Element size
typesize.description: Size of an element in bytes, used by the shuffle filter.

blocksize.title: Block size
blocksize.description: Size of the blocks compressed independently, in bytes; 0 chooses automatically.

name.title: CRC32C checksum codec
name.description: Appends a CRC32C checksum to detect corrupted chunks (bytes → bytes; core).

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Parameters of the crc32c checksum codec.

name.title: Sharding codec
name.description: Stores many inner chunks in one storage object (a shard) with an index of their byte ranges, so that small chunks can be read with range requests (array → bytes; core).

chunk_shape.title: Inner chunk shape
chunk_shape.description: Shape of the inner chunks of a shard.

codecs.title: Inner codecs
codecs.description: Codecs applied to each inner chunk.

index_codecs.title: Index codecs
index_codecs.description: Codecs applied to the shard index.

index_location.title: Index location
index_location.description: Whether the shard index is at the start or the end of the shard.

name.title: JPEG codec
name.description: Lossy JPEG encoding of 8-bit image chunks (array → bytes). Not registered in zarr-developers/zarr-extensions; written by hamk-uas/cards-zarr-optim and read by Observatory.

subsampling.title: Chroma subsampling
subsampling.description: Chroma subsampling of colour images, for example 4:2:0.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the extension, registered in zarr-developers/zarr-extensions or a URL.

must_understand.title: Must understand
must_understand.description: False when a reader that does not know the extension may ignore it.

dimension_names.title: Dimension names
dimension_names.description: Name of each dimension, or null for an unnamed one. Shared names relate the dimensions of different arrays, like netCDF dimensions.

storage_transformers.title: Storage transformers
storage_transformers.description: Transformations between the logical chunk keys and the store.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the extension, registered in zarr-developers/zarr-extensions or a URL.

must_understand.title: Must understand
must_understand.description: False when a reader that does not know the extension may ignore it.

consolidated_metadata.title: Consolidated metadata
consolidated_metadata.description: Metadata of all nodes below a group, copied into its `zarr.json` so that one request describes the whole hierarchy. Written by zarr-python 3; not part of the Zarr 3.1 core specification.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Where the consolidated metadata is stored.

must_understand.title: Must understand
must_understand.description: False: readers that do not know consolidated metadata may ignore it.

metadata.title: Node metadata
metadata.description: The `zarr.json` content of each descendant node, by path relative to this group.

must_understand.title: Must understand
must_understand.description: False: readers that do not know this extension field may ignore it. Other extensions of the node metadata are not allowed.
